meta.scope: regular season only; consolation and playoff games excluded
meta.extensions: rankheat_v1 (weekly score rank), streaks_v1 (cross-season regular-season H2H runs), rating_v1 (ELO K=24 base 1500, W/L only, season-end snapshots)

stability.note: Split-half is odd vs even regular-season weeks within a team-season, Spearman-Brown corrected to full-season length. Year-over-year pairs a franchise's season t with t+1. A luck metric SHOULD be near zero year-over-year - that is the evidence it is luck and not a repeatable skill. Lineup efficiency is 2018+ only.
